neighbourhoods.name: Sittingbourne

neighbourhoods.name: Milton Regis and Kemsley

neighbourhoods.name: Faversham

housing: Swale covers Sittingbourne, the market town of Faversham and the Isle of Sheppey. Private renting is close to the national average, with many lets in the Victorian terraces of Sittingbourne and Sheerness and in flats over shops. Sheppey also has large numbers of bungalows, holiday parks and chalets, some lived in all year. Sittingbourne and the villages around it have grown with big new-build estates for Medway and London commuters.
checkinTips: Coastal homes on Sheppey: check window frames, metal fittings, gutters and outside paintwork for salt and wind damage.
Bungalows and chalets in Minster and Leysdown: photograph roofs, flat-roof extensions, damp patches and any electric storage heaters.
Victorian terraces in Sittingbourne and Sheerness: record back yards, rear walls and any damp low on the walls.
Listed and period homes in Faversham: photograph sash windows, old floors, fireplaces and any cracks in plaster.
New-build estates around Iwade and Sittingbourne: note snagging marks, fences, turf and allocated parking.
tenantHelp: Private tenants can contact Swale Borough Council's Private Sector Housing team about disrepair, damp or unsafe conditions, or use the council's 'Complain about a landlord' page.
